notablePrerequisites: Paradox Haze and Copy Enchantment attached to you.
description:
Cast Chronomantic Escape by paying {4}{W}{W}, causing creatures to be unable to attack you until your next turn, and exiling Chronomantic Escape with three time counters on it.
During the first upkeep step of your next turn, Paradox Haze and Copy Enchantment each trigger, causing you to get two additional upkeep steps.
Move through your first and second upkeep steps, removing two time counters from Chronomantic Escape.
Move through your final upkeep step, removing the final time counter from Chronomantic Escape and causing you to cast it from exile without paying its mana cost.
Resolve Chronomantic Escape, causing creatures to be unable to attack you until your next turn, and exiling Chronomantic Escape with three time counters on it.
Repeat from step 2.

uses.name: Copy Enchantment
uses.cardState: as a copy of Paradox Haze.
